import json, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile; repo = pathlib.Path.cwd(); fz = repo / 'target/debug/fz'
root = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='fozzylang-trace-compat-'))
scenario = root / 'scenario.fozzy.json'
trace = root / 'recorded.trace.fozzy'
scenario.write_text(json.dumps({
  'version': 1,
  'name': 'trace-replay-compatibility-inner',
  'steps': [
    {'type': 'trace_event', 'name': 'boot'},
    {'type': 'proc_when', 'cmd': 'python3', 'args': ['-c', 'print("inner-proc")'], 'exit_code': 0, 'stdout': 'inner-proc\n', 'stderr': '', 'times': 1},
    {'type': 'memory_checkpoint', 'name': 'after_proc'},
    {'type': 'assert_eq_int', 'a': 1, 'b': 1}
  ]
}))
run_proc = subprocess.run([str(fz), 'run', str(scenario), '--det', '--record', str(trace), '--json'], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
run_payload = json.loads(run_proc.stdout.strip())
assert run_proc.returncode == 0, (run_proc.returncode, run_payload, run_proc.stderr)
assert run_payload['status'] == 'pass', run_payload
verify_proc = subprocess.run([str(fz), 'trace', 'verify', str(trace), '--strict', '--json'], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
verify_payload = json.loads(verify_proc.stdout.strip())
assert verify_proc.returncode == 0, (verify_proc.returncode, verify_payload, verify_proc.stderr)
assert verify_payload['ok'] is True, verify_payload
assert verify_payload['compatibility']['traceSchemaVersion'] == 'fozzy-trace.v4', verify_payload
assert any(check['name'] == 'compatibility_set' and check['ok'] for check in verify_payload['checks']), verify_payload
assert any(check['name'] == 'checkpoint_count_match' and check['ok'] for check in verify_payload['checks']), verify_payload
assert any(check['name'] == 'runtime_events_match' and check['ok'] for check in verify_payload['checks']), verify_payload
replay_proc = subprocess.run([str(fz), 'replay', str(trace), '--json'], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
replay_payload = json.loads(replay_proc.stdout.strip())
assert replay_proc.returncode == 0, (replay_proc.returncode, replay_payload, replay_proc.stderr)
assert replay_payload['status'] == 'pass', replay_payload
ci_proc = subprocess.run([str(fz), 'ci', str(trace), '--json'], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
ci_payload = json.loads(ci_proc.stdout.strip())
assert ci_proc.returncode == 0, (ci_proc.returncode, ci_payload, ci_proc.stderr)
assert ci_payload['ok'] is True, ci_payload
native_proc = subprocess.run([str(fz), 'trace-native', str(trace), '--json'], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
native_payload = json.loads(native_proc.stdout.strip())
assert native_proc.returncode == 0, (native_proc.returncode, native_payload, native_proc.stderr)
native_trace = pathlib.Path(native_payload['trace'])
native_manifest = pathlib.Path(native_payload['manifest'])
native_trace_payload = json.loads(native_trace.read_text())
native_manifest_payload = json.loads(native_manifest.read_text())
assert native_trace_payload['compatibility']['traceSchemaVersion'] == 'fozzy-trace.v4', native_trace_payload
assert native_trace_payload['checkpointCount'] == 1, native_trace_payload
assert len(native_trace_payload['runtimeEvents']) > 0, native_trace_payload
assert len(native_trace_payload['causalLinks']) > 0, native_trace_payload
assert native_manifest_payload['compatibility']['diagnosticCatalogVersion'] == 'fozzylang.diagnostic_catalog.v1', native_manifest_payload
native_replay_proc = subprocess.run([str(fz), 'replay', str(native_manifest), '--json'], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
native_replay_payload = json.loads(native_replay_proc.stdout.strip())
assert native_replay_proc.returncode == 0, (native_replay_proc.returncode, native_replay_payload, native_replay_proc.stderr)
assert native_replay_payload['status'] == 'pass', native_replay_payload
print('compiler-trace-replay-compatibility-ok')
